 (SELECT region, cloud_provider, bucket, max(commits.generation) generation, argMax(commits.revision, commits.generation) revision
  FROM benchmark_rollup_commits AS commits
  WHERE bucket + INTERVAL 1 MINUTE > $__fromTime_ms AND bucket < $__toTime_ms
  AND ((bucket >= $__fromTime_ms AND bucket + INTERVAL 1 MINUTE <= $__toTime_ms) OR bucket < now() - INTERVAL 6 HOUR) GROUP BY region, cloud_provider, bucket) c
 LEFT JOIN (SELECT region, cloud_provider, bucket, max(revision) revision FROM benchmark_dirty_minutes
  WHERE bucket + INTERVAL 1 MINUTE > $__fromTime_ms AND bucket < $__toTime_ms
  AND ((bucket >= $__fromTime_ms AND bucket + INTERVAL 1 MINUTE <= $__toTime_ms) OR bucket < now() - INTERVAL 6 HOUR) GROUP BY region, cloud_provider, bucket) d
 ON c.region = d.region AND c.cloud_provider = d.cloud_provider AND c.bucket = d.bucket WHERE c.revision >= d.revision)) AS rollup_generations
 SELECT * FROM (WITH observed AS (
 SELECT subscription_id, data_type, min(first_seen) AS first_seen, max(last_seen) AS last_seen
 FROM (SELECT region, cloud_provider, subscription_id, data_type, commitment, provider,
 first_seen, last_seen FROM benchmark_minute_rollups
 WHERE kind = 'provider' AND region = ${region:sqlstring} AND cloud_provider = ${cloud_provider:sqlstring}
 AND (${data_type:sqlstring} = '__all' OR data_type = ${data_type:sqlstring}) AND commitment = ${commitment:sqlstring} AND (region, cloud_provider, bucket, generation) IN (SELECT tupleElement(r, 1), tupleElement(r, 2), tupleElement(r, 3), tupleElement(r, 4)
 FROM (SELECT arrayJoin(rollup_generations) AS r))
 UNION ALL
 SELECT region, cloud_provider, subscription_id, data_type, commitment, provider,
 min(event_utc) AS first_seen, max(event_utc) AS last_seen
 FROM benchmark_event_lags WHERE region = ${region:sqlstring} AND cloud_provider = ${cloud_provider:sqlstring}
 AND (${data_type:sqlstring} = '__all' OR data_type = ${data_type:sqlstring}) AND commitment = ${commitment:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter_ms(event_utc) AND (region, cloud_provider, toStartOfMinute(event_utc)) IN (
 SELECT region, cloud_provider, toDateTime(second, 'UTC') AS bucket
 FROM (SELECT DISTINCT region, cloud_provider FROM benchmark_dirty_minutes
       UNION DISTINCT SELECT region, cloud_provider FROM benchmark_subscriber_locations
       UNION DISTINCT SELECT tupleElement(r, 1), tupleElement(r, 2)
       FROM (SELECT arrayJoin(rollup_generations) AS r))
 ARRAY JOIN range(toUInt32(toStartOfMinute(greatest($__fromTime_ms, now() - INTERVAL 6 HOUR))), greatest(toUInt32(toStartOfMinute(greatest($__fromTime_ms, now() - INTERVAL 6 HOUR))), toUInt32(toStartOfMinute($__toTime_ms)) + 60), 60) AS second
 WHERE (region, cloud_provider, bucket) NOT IN (SELECT tupleElement(r, 1), tupleElement(r, 2), tupleElement(r, 3) FROM (SELECT arrayJoin(rollup_generations) AS r)))
 GROUP BY region, cloud_provider, subscription_id, data_type, commitment, provider) GROUP BY subscription_id, data_type
), metadata AS (
 SELECT subscription_id, argMax(filters, registered_utc) AS filters
 FROM benchmark_subscription_versions
 WHERE (${data_type:sqlstring} = '__all' OR data_type = ${data_type:sqlstring}) AND commitment = ${commitment:sqlstring}
 GROUP BY subscription_id
), configurations AS (
 SELECT observed.*, metadata.filters AS filters,
 extractAll(metadata.filters, '"([^"]+)"') AS addresses,
 extract(metadata.filters, ';window=([^;]+)') AS window_setting,
 replaceAll(replaceRegexpAll(extract(metadata.filters, ';providers=([^;]+)'), '@[0-9a-f]+', ''), ',', ', ') AS provider_names,
 concat(multiIf(empty(metadata.filters), concat('Configuration ', substring(observed.subscription_id, 1, 8)),
   observed.data_type = 'slot', 'Slot updates',
   concat(if(observed.data_type = 'account', 'Account owner: ', 'Transactions include: '),
     if(empty(addresses), 'all', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(address ->
       concat(substring(address, 1, 6), '…', substring(address, -4)), arraySlice(addresses, 1, 3)), ', ')),
     if(length(addresses) > 3, concat(' +', toString(length(addresses) - 3), ' more'), ''))),
   if(window_setting = '', '', concat(' · window ', window_setting)),
   if(provider_names = '', '', concat(' · ', provider_names)))
 AS configuration
 FROM observed LEFT JOIN metadata ON observed.subscription_id = metadata.subscription_id
)
 SELECT subscription_id AS value,
 concat(configuration, ' · ', formatDateTime(last_seen, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%S'), ' UTC') AS label
 FROM configurations WHERE ${data_type:sqlstring} != '__all'
 ORDER BY last_seen DESC, subscription_id DESC)

Events while disconnected are excluded from comparisons rather than counted as dropped, so check downtime and disconnects alongside win and dropped rates.

panels.title: Disconnects
panels.description: Downtime: time each provider’s selected streams could not reconnect, counting outages that lasted at least 10 s from a disconnect until the next successful subscription, summed over streams. Disconnects: how often the streams were interrupted, including short reconnects (such as a rolling restart) that are not downtime. Disconnects caused by the subscriber’s own backlog (a full arrival or control queue) are excluded. Events while disconnected are excluded from comparisons rather than counted as dropped, so check downtime and disconnects alongside win and dropped rates.

options.content:
**Resolution:** ten-second detail for the latest six hours; minute summaries for longer or older views. Overview percentiles are exact up to one hour and approximate for longer views. Counts and wins stay exact. Ranges older than six hours are widened to whole minutes at their edges (raw detail has expired). Summary, connection and health history retain 30 days.

Bars summarize the selected time range. Graphs show each time bucket. Bars and trends use the selected region and cloud provider. **All** pools account, transaction and slot events, using the latest configuration per stream.

**Ideal provider:** the first arrival for each event across all configured providers. The winner can change each event. Lag is the delay behind that arrival, in milliseconds. Hiding a provider does not change this baseline. Example: A arrives first, B follows 4 ms later → A = 0 ms, B = 4 ms. This measures local delivery differences, not time since the event was produced.

**Dropped = not delivered within 5 seconds.** Each event opens a 5 s window at the first provider’s delivery. A connected provider that has not delivered by then counts as **dropped** for that event, even if its delivery arrives later. Later deliveries are ignored; there is no “late” category.

**Percentiles:** lower is better. **p50 = 4 ms** means roughly half of a provider’s on-time deliveries lagged the ideal by 4 ms or less. **p99 = 20 ms** means roughly 99% lagged by 20 ms or less. p95 and p99.9 follow the same rule. Dropped events are excluded, so read percentiles together with the dropped rate.

**Comparing providers:** percentile samples can differ. Subtracting two p50 values does not tell you the median difference on shared events. Use **Head to Head** for that comparison.

**Win rate:** provider wins ÷ combined wins of selected providers. A win is the first on-time delivery of an event that at least two connected providers competed for; a provider that **drops** an event loses it to every provider that delivered it. First-place ties are excluded. Example: A wins 60 times and B wins 40 → 60% and 40%. Hidden providers still compete. Shares sum to 100%; no selected wins means no data.

**Downtime:** events while a provider is disconnected are excluded from its comparisons, not counted as dropped. **Downtime** counts only outages of at least 10 s, when reconnecting kept failing; **Disconnects** counts every interruption, including quick reconnects.

**Dropped rates and controls:** dropped rates are raw observations of connected providers; time while a provider is disconnected or coverage is unknown is not counted as dropped. Toggle markers under **Controls → Connections / Disconnections**. Connection status alone does not prove healthy coverage. Hover any graph to sync the time cursor.
